en: A vintage multi-view color postcard titled "GRAZ." showing nine small scenes of the city. The views include a riverside panorama with a hill and fortification, a city park fountain with people walking, an overlook with a bear statue and wide valley view, a wooded lake, the ornate city hall on a busy square, a city square with trams and buildings, a grand opera house, a bridge over the river with adjacent school buildings, and a street scene with tall corner building and row of houses. Each vignette has a short red German caption naming the location.
